title: Primitive Positive Constructions Among Finite Permutation Groups
summary: Primitive positive constructions of first order structures have been shown to be a very useful tool in universal algebra for the study of constraint satisfaction problems. However, they seemed to be very rarely studied in classical algebra such as group theory. This paper fills in this gaps by looking at structures and obstructions based on permutation groups and giving a full classification in this sub-area.
